summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The SMART Earnings Growth 30 ETF (SGRT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund actively invests in equity securities of 30 US large-cap companies, selected based on their above-market earnings growth potential. Constituents are market cap-weighted. SGRT was launched on Aug 20, 2025 and is issued by Smart.

holdings.infoBox: SGRT is an equity ETF with a total of 26 individual holdings. The top holdings are Datadog stock at 14.82%, Western Digital at 10.72%, Dell Technologies at 10.57%, AGNC Investment at 8.58%, and Micron Technology at 7.66%.
